description: Manage a release's smart-link landing page. Pick ONE action with `action`: `update_landing_config` replaces the configuration with `config` (required for this action) — `config.actions` uses the v2 action-list contract (one entry per call-to-action); other keys: links_page_enabled, config_mode, page_style, custom_cta_text, custom_description, pre_order_links. `create_short_url` creates (or returns the existing) short URL for the landing page — safe to repeat.

config.description: The landing-page configuration to set (required for update_landing_config).

name: manage_release_links
title: Manage a release smart link
